API.md

5 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Shared authoring API: legacy schema 1, motion schema 2.

Package godot:box3d/authoring, input types are in types.odin. bake(Scene_Input, allocator=context.allocator) -> (Baked_Scene, Diagnostic); parse_and_bake(json_bytes:[]u8, allocator=context.allocator) -> (Baked_Scene, Diagnostic); destroy(^Baked_Scene); build(^Baked_Scene, profile:u64) -> (Built_Scene, Diagnostic); built_destroy(^Built_Scene) -> b.Status.

JSON uses the EXACT field names/types of Scene_Input, Body_Input and Shape_Input. Vectors are arrays, poses are {position:[x,y,z],rotation:[x,y,z,w]}. Types/kinds are lowercase strings. Body.shapes is the resource list, copied inline; no engine values, paths, instance IDs or runtime handles. Extractors emit all fields using the defaults in types.odin, not omitted implicit defaults. Sphere center and Capsule centers_a/centers_b are exact local endpoints, not height surrogates. Heightfield rows are Z and columns X, positive spacing. Positive scale only; sphere/capsule require uniform scale. Body/world transforms are rigid; all resource scale/local_pose is baked into exact native geometry.

Body identity hashes namespace+body key. Shape identity hashes namespace+body key+resource key. Authored resource identity hashes namespace+key. Native catalog identity hashes canonical baked geometry and namespace: identical geometry has ONE catalog ID even for distinct resources. Scene_Data.resources preserves each authored resource key/logical ID/catalog mapping. The same resource key may be reused on different bodies ONLY with identical baked geometry; it is one immutable catalog asset. Duplicate body keys or duplicate shape keys on a body, conflicting reused resources, u64/u32 collisions and zero IDs fail before publication. Authored logical IDs do not depend on insertion order or geometry content; native catalog IDs bind geometry content. SHA256 scene identity binds the baked semantic data. Arrays are sorted by stable keys before native construction. No native allocation identities are IDs.

Limits preserve current 35 bodies/35 shapes/32 dynamic/8 catalog assets and 64MiB envelope; Hull 4..256 points, Mesh 4096 vertices/24576 indices, 64x64 heightfield and 2MiB input. Non-origin/rotated boxes become exact eight-vertex hulls. Mesh/heightfield require Static, non-sensor and enable_sensor_events=false (the mesh/heightfield default). Explicit unsupported flags fail validation; the builder never drops them. Builder owns a native world, immutable trusted catalog and local logical-ID-to-native-key maps; geometry temporaries are released after shape retention. Every failure destroys the partial unpublished candidate.

Native advanced-catalog ABI is in box3d/native/authoring_catalog.h: V2 descriptor size72/align8 on supported64-bit targets, verified through actual C layout queries. Legacy primitive catalogs remain recovery1; authored catalogs are recovery2. Pure5, Native-facing Odin3 and both framework cases pass on the declared macOS reference; Native Debug/Release/ASanUBSan11each and actual Godot SDK resource/scene roundtrip/source-free construction pass. Export GateC remains separate.

P5.2 motion additions (validated on the recorded P5.2 graph):

scene_input_default(namespace, schema_version=1) preserves the P5.1 default; pass 2 for motion. Schema1 accepts no joints/characters and retains its exact old content-hash projection and authored recovery2 catalog. Schema2 binds appended motion arrays and uses recovery_catalog_create_v3/recovery3. Both schemas retain the original body/shape/resource IDs. Logical joint/character IDs use distinct joint/character domains, namespace+stable_key, never native keys.

Scene_Input.joints:[]Joint_Input (maximum ONE) contains stable_key, lowercase kind (pin, hinge, slider, spherical, distance, motor, weld, wheel), body_a/body_b authored stable-key strings, local_frame_a/b Pose_Input, common force_threshold/torque_threshold/constraint_hertz/constraint_damping_ratio f32, collide_connected bool, and named axis, distance, spherical, motor, weld, wheel settings. These named settings exactly mirror the public fixed-width types in box3d/joints.odin / native/motion.h. Their Vec3/Quat values are JSON objects {x,y,z} / {x,y,z,w}; frame poses remain arrays as above. Unused setting blocks must be zero. joint_input_default is a pure explicit authoring default, while b.motion_joint_default exposes the pinned engine's actual defaults. Angles are radians, linear lengths metres. Axis flags spring1/limit2/motor4; spherical flags spring1/cone2/twist4/motor8; wheel flags suspensionSpring1/suspensionLimit2/ spinMotor4/steering8/steeringLimit16. Pin maps Spherical with angular flags OFF; Hinge maps Revolute Z; Slider maps Prismatic X. Reject missing/self/two-static bodies, invalid poses/settings/flags/limits and unsupported unused blocks before publishing a bake. Build resolves Body_Key only after all bodies, then creates actual constraints transactionally and publishes local Joint_Key maps.

Scene_Input.characters:[]Character_Input contains stable_key, optional exclude_body authored body key (empty means none), config and initial. Config fields are max_slides (1..8), capsule {center1:[3],center2:[3],radius}, up[3] (normalized by bake), floor_cosine[0..1], category_bits/mask_bits:u64 and include_sensors:bool. Initial is {position:[3],velocity:[3]}. Initial grounding is explicitly unavailable/zero until actual movement; no authored native ground key. character_input_default gives the exact source defaults. All storage is copied; config/state are not live Godot references. Built character maps contain the copied config with resolved optional self Body_Key and initial POD.

Public runtime wrappers are b.motion_joint_default/create, b.query_aabb, b.query_ray_sorted (old query_ray unchanged), b.query_capsule/capsule_cast, and b.character_step(world,config,state,dt)->(Character_Result,Status). All 13 C record layouts/fields are independently queried by motion_abi_check. New queries return COMPLETE sorted Motion_Hit sets keyed by Shape_Key/Body_Key; Capacity returns exact required count with no truncated prefix. Character uses the actual engine capsule/plane mover; dt0 is no-op, otherwise fixed1/60 only. It returns explicit caller-owned POD, never changes a body or owns a tick. The framework is responsible for storing/reverting that state with its transaction.

P5.3 detached artifact/editor surface (first source checkpoint, uncompiled):

artifact_create(definition_json, Import_Metadata, allocator)->(Owned_Artifact, Artifact_Diagnostic); artifact_load(encoded, allocator)->(Owned_Artifact, Artifact_Diagnostic); artifact_destroy(^Owned_Artifact); import_metadata(source_uri,source_revision). One owning artifact contains its owning shared Baked_Scene, copied source/import metadata and encoded bytes; definition_json is a read-only view into encoded and must not be deleted separately. Assignment aliases ownership. Failure publishes empty output and cleans the local candidate. Loading makes an independent owner.

Version1 binary header is exactly200 bytes, little-endian: magic OGB3ART1[8], artifact_version:u32,header_bytes:u32,scene_schema:u32,import_version:u32, source_length:u32,metadata_length:u32,payload_length:u64; then source_sha256, bake_sha256,metadata_sha256,payload_sha256,shared_bake_sha256 (each32 bytes). Payload is canonical Import_Metadata JSON followed by EXACT source JSON bytes. Lengths must match the whole file with no trailing bytes. Source<=2MiB, metadata<=16KiB, bounded parser scratch and all existing bake limits apply. Importer ogb3.authoring/version1 and nonempty source_uri are explicit; an empty source_revision is unavailable. Shared-bake identity fingerprints actual types/bake/motion source. Load checks all versions/hashes, rebakes once, compares semantic identity and canonical envelope. No Native memory/ABI/handles are stored. Semantic bake identity survives equivalent scene order while exact source and artifact identity correctly change. This is corruption checking, not authentication.

artifact_inspect_json returns one owning JSON buffer. Durable u64 IDs are exact 16hex strings, catalog IDs8hex; metadata includes source/import/schema/bake identities/counts. Optional authored SHAPE preview delegates debug_preview (the shared pure outline generator), no fake frame/stamp or Native world. Optional Godot module methods and installation are in addons/box3d_authoring/tool_module.
